facts.text: The rangers have liaison offices from the Yamatai National Police and the Yamatai Security Agency at their HQ.
Individual rangers have a reputation for self-sufficiency, self-reliance, and extended solo patrols and missions.
The rangers as an organization require a good deal of interagency support.
The Empress of Yamatai can overrule the Senate and even the Constitution.
The Empress of Yamatai typically never overrules the Senate or the Constitution.
Yamatai is an empire consisting of a central state.
Yamatai is an empire consisting of a federation of numerous suzerainties under it.
The suzerainties under Yamatai generally have wide latitude and autonomy on handling their local affairs.
